en: Vintage colored postcard showing a grand multi‑story historicist building with ornate façades and red-tiled roofs, looking over a tree‑filled area and several surrounding buildings. The sky is softly tinted blue and pink. Hungarian text identifying the scene appears at the top right of the image. The reverse side is blank except for printed Hungarian heading and dividing lines typical of an early 20th‑century postcard.
